name: @ifiokjr/dotfiles-cli
description: Unified CLI for managing dotfiles — setup, rebuild, reload, and more.

tasks.coverage: rm -rf coverage && DOTFILES_CLI_COVERAGE_DIR=coverage deno test --allow-all --coverage=coverage && deno coverage --ignore=commands --lcov --output=coverage/lcov.info coverage && deno run --allow-read --allow-env test/coverage_threshold.ts coverage/lcov.info 90
tasks.check:all: deno check main.ts && deno run -A npm:oxlint@1.67.0 . && deno lint
